title: Auto Loans: application entry thresholds by loan product
content:
# Auto Loans: application entry thresholds by loan product

This quick-reference card belongs to the Auto Loans product category of Piedmont Crescent Bank (PCB). It sets out, for each of the six Auto Loans products, the minimum applicant age, the most loans of that product one customer may hold, the range of the amount financed, and the loan-to-value ceiling.

## Meaning of each threshold

- **Minimum age**: the youngest age, in whole years, at which a person may apply.
- **Loans of this product per customer**: the most loans of that same product, in applied, active or delinquent status, that one customer may hold; a whole count.
- **Minimum and maximum amount financed**: the smallest and the largest amount financed, in USD.
- **Loan-to-value ceiling**: the largest amount financed, expressed as a percent of the vehicle's value. The vehicle's value is the lower of the purchase price and the book value.

The entry gate of every Auto Loans product includes three tests drawn from this card: the applicant's age is at least the minimum age, the amount financed lies between the minimum and the maximum amount, and the amount financed is at most the loan-to-value ceiling.

## Threshold table (all products)

| Auto Loans product | Minimum age (years) | Loans of this product per customer | Minimum amount financed (USD) | Maximum amount financed (USD) | Loan-to-value ceiling (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Used Vehicle Loan | 18 | 2 | 5000.00 | 75000.00 | 110 |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan | 18 | 2 | 7500.00 | 90000.00 | 120 |
| Auto Refinance Loan | 18 | 2 | 7500.00 | 90000.00 | 110 |
| Lease Buyout Loan | 18 | 1 | 10000.00 | 90000.00 | 110 |
| New Vehicle Loan | 18 | 2 | 7500.00 | 125000.00 | 125 |
| Green Vehicle Loan | 18 | 2 | 7500.00 | 125000.00 | 125 |

## Points of judgement

**Which value is the "vehicle's value" in the ceiling test?** The lower of the purchase price and the book value, never the higher.

**Is the Lease Buyout Loan limit the same as the others?** No. A customer may hold at most 1 Lease Buyout Loan in applied, active or delinquent status; every other product allows 2.

## Worked illustration (hypothetical vehicle)

Hypothetical inputs: a Used Vehicle Loan request on a vehicle with a purchase price of 30000.00 and a book value of 28000.00.

1. The vehicle's value is the lower figure, 28000.00.
2. The Used Vehicle Loan ceiling is 110 percent; 110 percent of 28000.00 is 30800.00.
3. A requested amount financed of 30800.00 is at the ceiling and passes this test; 30800.01 exceeds it and fails.
4. Separately, the amount must lie between 5000.00 and 75000.00 for this product.
